history.overview: The Core is the strategic and arcane heart of the Muramite Citadel.

timeline.name: Core Construction
timeline.description: Muramite forces built the Core as the center of Citadel operations.

timeline.name: Reactor Installation
timeline.description: Discord reactors were installed to power Citadel infrastructure.

timeline.name: Arcane Ward Network
timeline.description: Arcane conduits and wards were established to reinforce defenses.

timeline.name: High Command Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite high command moved into the Core to direct operations.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Core remains the most secure and dangerous Muramite stronghold.
